messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: increased 5xx/timeout rate observed on /v1/generate across multiple regions. Alerting if >1.5% errors over 5m. Baseline was ~0.1%. Please acknowledge.
Chris: ack. I'm oncall. seeing spikes from a small subset of clients hitting long-running streaming calls concurrently.
Maria: ack from SRE. initial quick check: memory pressure on a subset of nodes + degraded kernel network queues in eu-west-1. Not a full outage but error amplification for high-concurrency streaming requests.
Jules: paging infra. We spun up replacement nodes but autoscaler lagged. Rolling out more capacity now; ETA ~6m for ASG to stabilize.
Chris: temporary mitigation we can do from control plane: 1) apply per-tenant burst rate limit at the ingress LB 2) lower default streaming session concurrency for hosted tier 3) route heavy traffic to best-effort pool. Can we do per-org rate cap?
Maria: yes, we can inject an emergency rate cap on the heavy orgs by org-id. I propose: 200 rps per org for 10 minutes, re-evaluate. That should prevent overload while we add nodes.
Chris: doing that now. @Devex please push a note to SDK users with short mitigation guidance (retry/backoff + idempotency) so clients don't hammer retries and make it worse. Small code snippet + config change.
Devex: will draft. Quick question: should we ask users to disable streaming temporarily? Some of our logs show a lot of stalled streams.
Jules: yes, for affected orgs we can downgrade streaming->non-streaming (single response) as a fallback for generate. Not ideal but lower resource footprint.
Devex: drafting message for SDKs: short, prescriptive, copy-paste. Will send here for review.
Devex: (draft) "If you see increased 5xx/timeout from Redwood: 1) reduce parallel requests from your worker pool to <= 8 per host, 2) implement exponential backoff with full jitter for 429/5xx, 3) add idempotency keys for non-streaming generation to avoid duplicate side effects, 4) prefer non-streaming calls while we mitigate"
Chris: looks good. Add recommended backoff numbers and a small JS + Python snippet. Also mention which status codes to retry and which not to (don't retry 4xx besides 429).
Devex: added details: 
Devex: "Recommended retry policy:
- Retry on 429, 502, 503, 504, and transient timeouts (network-level).
- Do NOT retry on 400/401/403/404/422.
- Use exponential backoff with full jitter: base=500ms, factor=2, max=16s, max_attempts=6. Example pseudo-code:
```js
async function backoff(attempt){
  const base = 500; // ms
  const max = 16000;
  const jitter = Math.random();
  const wait = Math.min(max, base * Math.pow(2, attempt)) * jitter;
  await sleep(wait);
}
```
"
Devex: Idempotency guidance: include `Idempotency-Key` header (uuidv4) on requests that mutate or create state. For generation calls that are safe to dedupe, add header so server can reliably return the same result or dedupe. For streaming: if retries are necessary, prefer non-streaming with idempotency to avoid partial duplicates.
Maria: small add: SDKs should honor `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers from our ingress. If a 429 includes Retry-After, backoff at least that long.
Chris: rolling mitigation update: per-org cap applied to top 7 orgs. Autoscaler now adding capacity; new nodes coming up. We'll keep streaming downgrade available for a second tier if error rate doesn't drop.
Devex: here's the short message I'll post to customers / SDK notice (one-paragraph):
"We are currently mitigating a high-error condition impacting streaming generation for a subset of customers. To avoid amplifying errors, please reduce client concurrency, implement exponential backoff with full jitter (base=500ms, max=16s, max_attempts=6), and add an Idempotency-Key header for non-streaming requests. The SDK patch to enable these defaults will be published in the next 30 minutes. We recommend temporarily preferring non-streaming calls until we confirm stability. Contact oncall@redwood if you need emergency quota adjustments."
Chris: LGTM. Post it. And @sdk-ci-bot kick a canary of the SDK patch with default retry changes (reduce parallelism in streaming client + enable idempotency header support).
sdk-ci-bot: canary job queued. test matrix includes: playback tests, rate-limit emulation, idempotency replay test.
Maria: monitoring: error rate down to 0.8% after caps; memory pressure easing. Keep an eye for regression after canary.
Jules: runbook note: for future incidents we should have a pre-approved SDK rollback/patch flow that can be executed under 20 minutes. Create ticket?
Chris: creating ticket now. ticket/INF-7823 created. I'll include runbook changes and the exact control-plane steps we did (per-org cap, stream-downgrade).
Devex: posted customer notice to #customer-facing-notices and sent to major affected orgs. Also opened a PR to SDK repo with default policy change (backoff + idempotency header) — PR link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/891
Maria: handoff @Chris -> @Jules in 30m. If error rebounds, escalate to infra leads.
Chris: handing off. leaving notes in the incident doc. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Jules: taking over. continuing monitoring. will coordinate with infra if nodes don't stabilize.
incident-bot: Incident summary updated: mitigation=per-org rate caps + streaming downgrade available; status=stabilizing; severity=sev3; assignees=[Chris,Jules,Maria]."
